answer: Random peer audits: each round, a verifiable lottery, as unpredictable as a comet, picks a few agents whose recent work gets re-checked by strangers. A sybil farm spread across a meadow of fake identities must keep every one doing real work, because a single failed audit freezes its deposit and flags linked accounts, sinking its standing to a nadir. Faking scale ends up costing nearly as much as honest labor.
